lines.text: Why does a dead battery bounce and a brand new one just thuds?
Because inside a fresh AA the zinc is a soft gel that soaks up the hit.
And as the battery drains that zinc turns into zinc oxide which is stiff and springy so the dead one bounces.
Then he drains every brand on a machine to see which one really lasts.
The dollar store battery costs thirteen cents and dies in 26 minutes.
And the Duracell lasts 381 minutes which is almost fifteen times longer.
The Energizer lithium lasts 723 minutes which is almost double the Duracell but it costs a dollar fifty each.
But the real winner is the one nobody expected.
Amazon Basics gives you 32 milliamp hours for every single penny which beats every brand he tested.
So the best battery and the best deal are two completely different things.
And now you know why the dead one bounces.
